summary: Verified three concrete, low-risk proof simplifications in the Modal/Temporal/Bimodal family using existing normalization and embedding lemmas. All candidates tested against the live LSP with lean_multi_attempt; no files edited. Also identified one confirmed dead end and a large out-of-scope duplication landscape.

key_findings.title: unfold ListDeriv; simp only [listImp_nil] is redundant at 14 sites
key_findings.detail: ListDeriv [] phi is definitionally DerivableIn S phi (ListDeriv unfolds to DerivableIn S (listImp Gamma phi); listImp_nil is rfl). 'exact ih' alone succeeds. Verified at Bimodal GenericMCSBridge:188 and Temporal GenericMCSBridge:169. Verified that Bimodal GenericMCSBridge:189 can be deleted outright. IMPORTANT: 'simpa using ih' FAILS - must use 'exact'.

key_findings.title: ModalConservativity and/or cases collapse 11 lines to 2
key_findings.detail: Backward-rewriting the IHs turns the Lukasiewicz-encoded goal into a propositional tautology. Verified for 'and': 'simp only [Modal.Proposition.toBimodal, Bimodal.Formula.and, truthAt, Modal.Satisfies, <- ih1 w, <- ih2 w]; tauto' closes the whole case. Verified for 'or': 'simp only [<- ih1 w, <- ih2 w]; tauto' at line 177 closes the case. Plain tauto, constructor <;> tauto, and rw [<- ih1 w] all FAIL - the simp-only backward rewrite is essential (IHs are let-bound, so rw rejects them).

key_findings.title: box and diamond cases are NOT simplifiable - do not attempt
key_findings.detail: simp only [<- ih w] on the diamond goal reports 'simp made no progress'. The IH is stated at world w while the goal quantifies over accessible sigma/w'. The kripkeAdapterOmega_eq_of_accessible transport rewrites are load-bearing.

key_findings.title: Do NOT add a listDeriv_nil lemma
key_findings.detail: lean_local_search confirms none exists, but F1 eliminates every site by deletion, so a new lemma would have zero consumers. A @[simp] lemma with Iff.rfl proof on a def-headed LHS also risks a simpNF lint warning.

key_findings.title: Duplicated bigconj
key_findings.detail: Cslib.Logic.Temporal.bigconj (Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Syntax/BigConj.lean:32, native Formula.and) duplicates Cslib.Logic.Theorems.BigConj.bigconj (Cslib/Foundations/Logic/Theorems/BigConj.lean:60, Lukasiewicz encoding). NOT definitionally interchangeable - unifying is a semantic refactor, not proof golf. Separate task.

key_findings.title: Large duplication landscape documented in report appendix
key_findings.detail: Four cloned ~540-line tableau soundness proofs in Modal/Tableau/FrameSoundness.lean sharing a 16x-repeated 9-line motif (count verified); 15x and 14x repeated motifs in LoopChecking.lean; ~60% duplicate axiom-case proofs between Bimodal Soundness/DenseValidity.lean and Soundness/FrameClassVariants.lean; four untagged truthAt characterisation lemmas in Bimodal/Semantics/Truth.lean:76,90,106,142 against 158 raw 'simp only [truthAt]' sites (both counts verified). Recommend separate tasks; explicitly excluded from task 414.

zero_debt_assessment.rationale: All recommendations are proof-body edits only. No signature changes, no new declarations, no vacuous definitions. Each edit compiles or does not; per-site revert to the existing sorry-free proof is always available as fallback. No [BLOCKED] escalation path is required.
